This was weighed in reasoning_quality; no pipeline defect implied.

All candidates froze distribution_count=1 before the petition's October 7, 2026 docketing; claude-baseline and codex-baseline identify that earlier distribution as concerning linked sealing motion 26M22. The October 14 petition distribution raises outcome.signals.distribution_count to two but does not itself show substantive reconsideration. gemini-baseline's forecast of no further relists is adverse on an additional-distribution reading but consistent on a narrower no-substantive-reconsideration reading. The forecast review records this ambiguity and limits its penalty; no event, outcome, frozen context, or harness-scored quantitative claim was changed.

That row is unobserved, so execution success and returned content cannot be determined. The discrepancy is in the retrieval account, not proof of outcome retrieval; the query does not seek this petition's November 9 disposition, and no leakage exclusion is imposed.
